entities.summary: Brennan Othmann is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a left winger for the Calgary Wranglers of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted in the first round, 16th overall, by the New York Rangers in the 2021 NHL entry draft.
